answer: An operator copying one text across 59 aliases therefore pays for 59 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. Since the terrace hash is stored at intake, the reef graph groups the endorsements and the ember audit publishes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
